Modern Developer Platform","styleGuidelines":"## Brand & Style

The Replicate homepage aesthetic is high-precision, developer-first, and ultra-modern. It eliminates any vintage warm cream or notebook influences in favor of deep obsidian/black surfaces, sharp white typography, thin technical borders, and an electric full-width halftone dither gradient transitioning across violet, magenta, rust, and chartreuse.

Visual feel:
- Minimalist, high-contrast, technical precision.
- Jet-black canvas accented with crisp white primary CTA buttons and hairline neutral borders.
- Code-first confidence with monospace syntax highlights and live output demonstration cards.

## Layout & Spacing

### Desktop (1280px viewport)
- **Top Promo Banner**: 40px fixed height, subtle border-b, centered text announcement.
- **Main Header**: 72px height, full-width with 64px horizontal padding, featuring Replicate wordmark, bordered inline search input, navigation links (Explore, Pricing, Enterprise, Docs, Blog, Sign in), and rectangular white "Try for free" CTA.
- **Hero Section**:
  - Headline coordinates start at approximately x: 64px, y: 200px.
  - Paired subhead and rectangular white "Get started for free" button.
  - Split content at y: 510px: Black multi-language code tabs (Node, Python, HTTP) on the left side, example output image card on the right, superimposed over the dense halftone dither gradient.
- **Downstream Layout**: Content-dense 12-column grid organizing model collection pills/filters, model cards, How it works multi-column code blocks, Scale section, and structured footer.

### Mobile (390px viewport)
- **Promo Bar**: 40px height with condensed copy.
- **Header**: 72px height with logo mark, search trigger icon, and Menu trigger.
- **Hero**: 48px headline starting at x: 24px, stacked white CTA, code block at y: ~466px, with the generated image card stacked directly underneath.

## Elevation & Depth

- **Zero Heavy Box-Shadows**: Depth is created using tonal layering and hairline borders (`1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12)`) rather than diffuse drop shadows.
- **Halftone Canvas Backdrop**: High-frequency procedural or SVG halftone dot pattern layered over the violet-to-chartreuse gradient provides spatial presence behind floating code and preview cards.
- **Code Panels & Cards**: Deep matte obsidian panels (`#09090b`) with hairline rims float cleanly over the chromatic background.

## Components

- **Primary Buttons**: Solid white fill, deep black text (`#000000`), bold/medium weight, 4px border-radius, rectangular geometry. Hover state subtle opacity (`0.92`).
- **Secondary Buttons / Ghost Actions**: Transparent background, 1px hairline border (`#27272a`), crisp white text, rectangular form factor.
- **Code Panels**: Black containers with top tab bar (Node.js, Python, HTTP/cURL, Cog), monospaced typography, colored syntax tokens (chartreuse strings, violet keywords, amber parameters), and inline copy-to-clipboard action.
- **Model Cards & Filters**: Structured cards with thumbnail previews, model namespace (`owner/model`), run counts, and category tags. Filter bar includes dense horizontal pills for multimodal tasks (Text, Diffusion, Audio, Video, Upscaling).

## Brand & Style

The Replicate homepage aesthetic is high-precision, developer-first, and ultra-modern. It eliminates any vintage warm cream or notebook influences in favor of deep obsidian/black surfaces, sharp white typography, thin technical borders, and an electric full-width halftone dither gradient transitioning across violet, magenta, rust, and chartreuse.

Visual feel:
- Minimalist, high-contrast, technical precision.
- Jet-black canvas accented with crisp white primary CTA buttons and hairline neutral borders.
- Code-first confidence with monospace syntax highlights and live output demonstration cards.

## Layout & Spacing

### Desktop (1280px viewport)
- **Top Promo Banner**: 40px fixed height, subtle border-b, centered text announcement.
- **Main Header**: 72px height, full-width with 64px horizontal padding, featuring Replicate wordmark, bordered inline search input, navigation links (Explore, Pricing, Enterprise, Docs, Blog, Sign in), and rectangular white "Try for free" CTA.
- **Hero Section**:
  - Headline coordinates start at approximately x: 64px, y: 200px.
  - Paired subhead and rectangular white "Get started for free" button.
  - Split content at y: 510px: Black multi-language code tabs (Node, Python, HTTP) on the left side, example output image card on the right, superimposed over the dense halftone dither gradient.
- **Downstream Layout**: Content-dense 12-column grid organizing model collection pills/filters, model cards, How it works multi-column code blocks, Scale section, and structured footer.

### Mobile (390px viewport)
- **Promo Bar**: 40px height with condensed copy.
- **Header**: 72px height with logo mark, search trigger icon, and Menu trigger.
- **Hero**: 48px headline starting at x: 24px, stacked white CTA, code block at y: ~466px, with the generated image card stacked directly underneath.

## Elevation & Depth

- **Zero Heavy Box-Shadows**: Depth is created using tonal layering and hairline borders (`1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12)`) rather than diffuse drop shadows.
- **Halftone Canvas Backdrop**: High-frequency procedural or SVG halftone dot pattern layered over the violet-to-chartreuse gradient provides spatial presence behind floating code and preview cards.
- **Code Panels & Cards**: Deep matte obsidian panels (`#09090b`) with hairline rims float cleanly over the chromatic background.

## Components

- **Primary Buttons**: Solid white fill, deep black text (`#000000`), bold/medium weight, 4px border-radius, rectangular geometry. Hover state subtle opacity (`0.92`).
- **Secondary Buttons / Ghost Actions**: Transparent background, 1px hairline border (`#27272a`), crisp white text, rectangular form factor.
- **Code Panels**: Black containers with top tab bar (Node.js, Python, HTTP/cURL, Cog), monospaced typography, colored syntax tokens (chartreuse strings, violet keywords, amber parameters), and inline copy-to-clipboard action.
- **Model Cards & Filters**: Structured cards with thumbnail previews, model namespace (`owner/model`), run counts, and category tags. Filter bar includes dense horizontal pills for multimodal tasks (Text, Diffusion, Audio, Video, Upscaling).
- **Search Bar**: Compact bordered input field with subtle slash (`/`) shortcut chip and magnifying lens icon.

2. **Hero & Interactive Prediction Playground**:
   - Signature dark aesthetic with subtle radial purple/magenta-to-amber glow.

   - Code playground featuring Node.js, Python, and HTTP tabs with an active snippet running `black-forest-labs/flux-1.1-pro`.

3. **Public Output Gallery & Updated Model Lineup**:
   - Live output gallery showcasing community generations: `High-fashion hyperrealistic portrait photography of an ethereal cyberpunk model with subtle iridescent chrome makeup and futuristic studio neon edge lighting, 85mm lens f/1.4 shallow depth of field` (cyberpunk portrait), `Cinematic macro wildlife photography of a vibrant neon chameleon on a dark mossy branch with dew drops, vivid lime green and violet skin texture, national geographic style` (macro neon chameleon), `Ultra-detailed 3D isometric isometric retro-futuristic synthesizer workstation with glowing vacuum tubes, analog dials, and cables, sleek dark matte aesthetic` (vintage synthesizer), and `Studio product photography of a quirky luxury modern designer armchair upholstered in yellow leather and soft velvet, creatively shaped like a partially peeled yellow banana, sculptural interior design object, dark neutral studio background, 8k hyperrealistic product render` (sculptural armchair).
   - Category filtering pills (*Generate images, Generate speech, Generate music, Restore images, Generate videos from images, Caption images, Large Language Models*).
   - Real, up-to-date model roster including **nano-banana-2.1**, **wan-3**, **seedance-2.5**, **realtime-tts-2**, **prunaai/p-video-2-pro**, and **krea/krea-2-medium**, as well as featured engines (**flux-2-flex, gpt-image-2, nano-banana-2**).

4. **Community & Developer Workflow**:
   - Creator badges covering top ecosystem contributors (@lucataco, @black-forest-labs, @meta, @bytedance, etc.).
   - 3-step *How it works* section detailing **01 / Run models** (cURL snippet), **02 / Train models on your own datasets** (LoRA training monitor), and **03 / Package any PyTorch code with Cog** (`cog.yaml` specification).

5. **Infrastructure & Footer**:
   - *Scale on Replicate* performance panel with live GPU allocation meters and cold-boot stats.

   - Full categorized footer with system status indicator (*All systems operational*).
